verdict.rationale: The Ministry of Corporate Affairs is a government company-registry service, not an agent, so publishing an official MCP server is a fair question and the axis applies. The evidence pack contains only two probes recording HTTP 403 responses at robots.txt for mca.gov.in and nsws.gov.in. Neither mentions an MCP server or any agent-connection endpoint, so there is no evidence the capability exists.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
